protocol.selection: all adjacent temporal cuts with fewer than 3 crossing landmarks, otherwise the first minimum-support cut; both directions; >32 cuts refuses rather than truncates
protocol.inference: OpenCV LK from existing cached observations only; native-depth provenance; target ownership exclusion; Kabsch/RANSAC even-ID fit, odd-ID verification; no pose prior or ground truth
protocol.acceptance: diagnostic only; report all proposals, rejected pairs, nonzero exits and resource failures; candidate acceptance does not authorize adding BA observations or establish point identity/absolute pose accuracy
protocol.stop: Finish these three previously seen sequences without changes to thresholds/selection; no BA, map mutation, online writeback, new downloads or test-set tuning

checks.initial_synthetic_failure: A half-contaminated fit split rejected a competing model; retained as explicit negative regression without algorithm changes

interpretation: all failed before image matching due to overstrict importer; zero geometric/performance result; original source and logs retained outside Git
